examples.label: Numbered setup steps for a new site
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-ul" site="Global" size="small" class="space-y-2">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" count={1}>Point your domain at the CMS name servers.</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" count={2}>Pick a starter layout and publish the home page.</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" count={3}>Invite your editors and hand out permissions.</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" count={4}>Connect analytics and switch the site live.</.component>
</.component>
